rooms.membersButtonTitle: See who is in this room

rooms.roomFull: A room holds at most {{max}} participants

rooms.displayNameInvalid: Names cannot contain spaces, @ or brackets and must be 24 characters or fewer.

rooms.rolePromptPlaceholder: Describe how this participant should behave.
rooms.personaPlaceholder: How this participant speaks and behaves. e.g. Skeptical and exacting; skips praise and names only the problems.
rooms.emptyTimeline: Send a message and the participants answer in turn. Use @name to choose who answers next.
rooms.showHostHistory: Show the conversation before the room
rooms.hideHostHistory: Hide the conversation before the room
rooms.hostHistoryEmpty: There was no conversation before this became a room.
rooms.hostHistoryFailed: Could not load the earlier conversation: {{error}}

rooms.composerPlaceholder: Type a message (@name to direct it)
rooms.maxAutoTurnsTitle: Auto-turn limit (1–{{max}}). Changes apply from the next turn, and participants are told how many turns remain
rooms.presetsDescription: Picking a preset fills in the name, role, instructions and personality. The list follows you across devices.
rooms.presetResetConfirm: Click again to restore the defaults
rooms.presetSaveCurrent: Save current input as a preset
rooms.leaveConfirm: Send {{name}} to standby? They stay in the room and simply stop getting turns. Mention @{{name}} to bring them back, still remembering where they left off.
rooms.leaveWhileSpeaking: Still answering — wait for the turn to end, or stop it first.
rooms.pendingHint: Goes out once the current participant finishes
rooms.interruptNowTitle: Cut the current participant off and handle your message first
rooms.splitWorkTitle: The lead splits the work and the assignees work at the same time
rooms.discussionTitle: After each reply, the others add a short opinion
rooms.hostLedTitle: Only participants the host calls with @name answer, and their reply goes back to the host. No opinion rounds or round-robin
rooms.autoCompactTitle: Before a participant's turn, compact its session with /compact once its context is over 60% full
rooms.editRoleHint: Changes take effect on this participant's next turn. Renaming also re-briefs the other participants with the new name.
rooms.standbyNoSession: Not called yet. Mention them by name to bring them in.
rooms.joinOnCallHint: Kept on the roster. They come in when called by name, answer, and go back to standby. Until then they use no session and no tokens.
rooms.joinNowHint: Joins right away and takes a turn in every round. Tokens add up quickly as the room grows.
rooms.permissionModeAllTitle: Changes the permission for the whole room at once, clearing any per-participant override.
rooms.compactAllTitle: Has every participant summarise its own history, shrinking the context each one carries. The room timeline is untouched.
rooms.compactOneTitle: Summarises this participant's history to shrink the context it carries.
rooms.compactWhileRunning: Not while participants are working. Wait for the round to end, or stop it first.
rooms.leaveRosterConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the roster? They have never been called, so there is no conversation to lose.
